testSet: 60 hand-labelled messages (12 po, 12 pr, 12 enquiry, 12 followup, 12 mdm) in regional English (Singlish, Malaysian, Thai/Vietnamese/Myanmar English, terse, forwarded threads), written blind before the rules were read and never used to tune them. 33 are deliberately tricky (PO numbers inside follow-ups, enquiries with quantities, MDM asks inside orders). Accuracy on tricky ones: 0.364; on plain ones: 0.593.
plain: On 60 messages written without seeing the rules, the rules put 47 of every 100 in the right stream (36 of 100 on the 33 deliberately tricky ones). A person still confirms every routing.

errors.subject: Change of billing address
errors.why: Rules saw: No PO number, quantity, question or setup request found — filed as a general enquiry for review. Actually a MDM request: Bill-to change. Mentions invoices (follow-up vocabulary).

errors.subject: Tempahan stok - microscope slides
errors.why: Rules saw: No PO number, quantity, question or setup request found — filed as a general enquiry for review. Actually a purchase request: Malay-English; 'LO' (Malaysian government local order = their PO) not yet issued.

errors.subject: Order
errors.why: Rules saw: States quantity 20 kits; Mentions product (rapid test). Actually a PO: Generic subject; PO in body. Myanmar.

errors.subject: Installation date for analyser
errors.why: Rules saw: Contains PO number PO 7781190; No quantity stated — check the attached order. Actually a follow-up: installation scheduling (post-delivery service) on an existing PO; question words.

errors.subject: re: urine cups
errors.why: Rules saw: No PO number, quantity, question or setup request found — filed as a general enquiry for review. Actually a PO: no 'PO' keyword at all ('order no ... raised in Ariba'); Singlish 'ok can, go ahead' looks like a PR acceptance.

errors.subject: Send PO No. 6910-0452 please confirm
errors.why: Rules saw: Refers to an existing order or billing ("invoice"). Actually a PO: mentions invoice (follow-up vocabulary) but is a new PO. Thai-English.
